ownerDefinitions.application-platform: Proposed functional role for internal service-to-service authentication contracts; a named accountable owner is still required.
ownerDefinitions.database-platform: Proposed functional role for Cloud SQL roles, migrations, and database recovery; a named accountable owner is still required.
ownerDefinitions.identity-security: Proposed functional role for JWT signing and authentication compatibility; a named accountable owner is still required.
ownerDefinitions.integration-platform: Proposed functional role for MSG91 and Google Drive provider credentials; a named accountable owner is still required.
ownerDefinitions.security-operations: Proposed functional role for privileged interactive and break-glass access; a named accountable owner is still required.

groups.prerequisite: Rotate the Cloud SQL role and Secret Manager version as one canary operation with a tested rollback credential.
Caller and receiver must support an overlap or dual-read window before the old version is disabled.
Implement key IDs and overlapping verification keys; wait at least the maximum refresh-token lifetime before retiring the prior key.
Create and validate the replacement at MSG91 before revoking the previous provider credential.
OAuth client IDs are identifiers; replace only when the provider application changes or is compromised.
Create a provider-side replacement, deploy a numeric Secret Manager version, validate import, then revoke the old credential.
Reset on compromise, ownership change, or access review failure; require a named custodian and tested break-glass recovery.
A privileged owner must classify the payload in place, without copying it to evidence, and remove the secret if it is non-credential static SQL.
